An ungainly attachment, the '''underslung scattergun''' was a single-shot [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrower]] that could be mounted onto another weapon. Though lacking in subtlety, it had gained popularity among [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and [[Gunslinger/Legends|gunslingers]] due to its low cost of 750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and powerful impact. This attachment was compatible only with [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] and [[Rifle/Legends|rifle]]-sized weapons. There existed a few models, such as the [["Leveller" Under-barrel Scattergun]] by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], the [[XZ03 Scattershell Slugthrower Attachment]] by [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc.|Merr-Sonn]] and [[Goseia Heavy Industries Concern/Legends|Goseia Heavy Industries Concern]]'s [["Troubleshooter" Underslung Slugthrower]].<ref name="Fly" />
